characters.description: A young woman with short reddish hair, a pale sleeveless top, brown trousers, fingerless gloves and a shoulder guard.
A small golden-brown dragon with horns, large eyes and pale wing membranes.

events.description: A sunlit city stretches toward a tall tower.
A red-haired woman walks through a narrow alley with a staff.
She holds open a large dark lid and peers underneath it.
She holds a rough brown piece of food in her gloved hand.
She climbs up onto a sloping tiled roof.
A small dragon crouches beside a chimney with blood on its torn wing.
The dragon's pale wing is ripped and blood pools on the roof.
The woman kneels beside the injured dragon.
She reaches out an open hand toward the dragon, which opens its mouth.
Inside a dim room, she cradles the dragon in her lap and tends its injured wing.
She smiles as she holds the dragon close.
She lowers a dark bowl onto a surface.
